en.title: Elizabeth Holmes Doc 'You Can See Everything' Drops Teaser, Promises Mind-Bending Journey
en.summary: Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim's intimate documentary on Elizabeth Holmes, 'You Can See Everything,' has unveiled its first teaser, offering a glimpse into the disgraced Theranos founder's life just before her prison sentence. The film, set for an October release, promises a deep dive into her enigmatic world.
en.body:
The world is getting its first look at **Nathan Fielder** and **Lance Oppenheim**'s highly anticipated documentary about **Elizabeth Holmes**, titled **'You Can See Everything.'** The teaser trailer, released recently, pulls back the curtain on the disgraced Theranos founder during a pivotal and intensely private period: the 34 days leading up to her incarceration. This A24-backed film promises an unprecedented look at Holmes, inviting a skeptical film crew to document her every move as her empire crumbled and her legal troubles mounted.

The film's synopsis hints at a journey far beyond a simple biographical account. What begins as an attempt at an intimate portrait of a notorious figure quickly evolves into something more profound and unsettling. "What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss," reads the official logline, suggesting that Fielder and Oppenheim have captured a complex narrative that delves into the psychological and societal implications of Holmes's rise and fall.

## A Glimpse into the Abyss

The teaser itself offers compelling visuals of Holmes, showcasing her intense interactions with Fielder, who appears to be a central figure in her final days of freedom. The project, initially kept under wraps, was given a surprise screening at the Telluride Film Festival, generating significant buzz among critics and industry insiders. The collaboration between the absurdist humorist **Nathan Fielder** and the documentarian **Lance Oppenheim**, known for his work on **'Primetime,'** creates a unique dynamic, blending Fielder's knack for observational discomfort with Oppenheim's talent for crafting compelling narratives from real-life subjects.

> "Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move."

The film's premise taps into the public's enduring fascination with **Elizabeth Holmes** and the Theranos scandal, a story that captivated headlines for years. Her promise of revolutionary blood-testing technology, which ultimately proved to be a massive fraud, led to a dramatic downfall and a conviction for wire fraud and conspiracy. The documentary aims to explore the woman behind the headlines during this critical juncture.

## Fan Frenzy and Anticipation

The reveal of **'You Can See Everything'** has ignited considerable excitement within fan communities who follow both **Nathan Fielder**'s unique brand of filmmaking and the unfolding saga of **Elizabeth Holmes**. Many are eager to see how Fielder's signature blend of awkwardness and empathetic observation will translate to such a high-stakes, real-world subject. The documentary's potential to offer new insights into Holmes's mindset, motivations, and the complex circumstances surrounding her downfall has made it one of the most talked-about non-fiction films of the year. The involvement of A24, known for its critically acclaimed and often unconventional films, further heightens expectations for a thought-provoking and visually striking piece of cinema.

## What's Next

**'You Can See Everything'** is slated for release in theaters this October. With the teaser now out, audiences can anticipate more promotional material and critical reviews as the release date approaches, offering further clues into this deep dive into one of Silicon Valley's most compelling and controversial figures.

content_raw: The A24 docudrama about the Theranos founder and convicted fraudster had a surprise screening at the Telluride Film Festival.
